reviews.title: Latest update (updated)
reviews.text:
Thank you for listening to user feedback and for making the recent improvements. I really appreciate the corrected line spacing in landscape mode and the new option to disable scrolling.

However, there is still one important issue that I hope you will consider addressing. When reading the Quran in landscape mode on an iPhone, only about four or five lines of text are clearly visible. The faded header and footer at the top and bottom of the screen further reduce the readable area, making it feel as though only three lines are comfortably readable.

I understand that some users may appreciate having the header and footer visible at all times. However, this should be an optional feature. Please provide a setting to disable the permanently visible, faded header and footer, allowing users to see them only when scrolling toward the top or bottom of the page.

This would maximize the available reading area and make reading the Quran in landscape mode much more comfortable. Thank you again for your responsiveness and for continuing to improve this app.
